Custom function
```{r}

mfd <- function(x){formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")}
mff <- function(x,y=1){formatC(x*100, format = "f", digits = y)}

mfc <- function(x){
  rsum <- rowSums(x)>0
  csum <- colSums(x)>0
  x[rsum,csum]
}

mf_cal_domi <- function(x){
  {colSums(x)/sum(x)*colSums(x>0)/nrow(x)} %>% 
    enframe(name="species",value="domi")
}

mf_change_str <- function(x, df, out = 2) {
  from <- df[[3 - out]]
  to   <- df[[out]]
  i <- match(x, from)
  x[!is.na(i)] <- to[i[!is.na(i)]]
  x
}

mf_get_idx <- function(sample_coord, sub_rep=100,seed=NULL){
  max_sample <- nrow(sample_coord)
  map(
    seq.int(1L, max_sample),
    function(i){
      sub_rep_real <- min(sub_rep,choose(max_sample, i))
      
      idx_sub <- comboSample(
        v=seq_len(max_sample), 
        m=i, 
        n=sub_rep_real,
        seed=seed
      ) %>% 
        asplit(1)
    }
  )
}

mf_cal_area <- function(sample_coord,idx,buf=1000){
  x <- sample_coord[, 1]
  y <- sample_coord[, 2]
  map(
    idx,
    function(i){
      sample_area <- map_dbl(
        i,
        function(k){
          xk <- x[k]
          yk <- y[k]
          hull <- chull(xk, yk)
          nh <- length(hull)
          xh <- xk[hull]
          yh <- yk[hull]
          
          a0 <- pi*buf^2
          al <- 0
          ah <- 0
          
          if(nh>1){
            al <- buf*sum(sqrt(diff(c(xh,xh[1]))^2+diff(c(yh,yh[1]))^2))
          }
          
          if(nh>2){
            ah <- abs(
              sum(xh*c(yh[-1],yh[1]) - yh*c(xh[-1],xh[1]))
            )*0.5
          }
          
          a <- (a0+al+ah)*1e-6
          
          return(a)
        }
      )
      dat <- tibble(
        sample_n=length(i[[1]]),
        sample_area=sample_area,
        intensity=sample_n/sample_area
      )
      return(dat)
    }
  ) %>% 
    list_rbind()
}

mf_cal_sp <- function(fish_mat,idx){
  map(
    idx,
    function(i,j){
      max_sample <- nrow(fish_mat)
      sub_rep_real <- length(i)
      subsample_mat <- matrix(
        F, 
        nrow = sub_rep_real, 
        ncol = max_sample
      )
      row_idx <- rep(seq_len(sub_rep_real),each=length(i[[1]]))
      col_idx <- unlist(i)
      subsample_mat[cbind(row_idx,col_idx)] <- T
      sp <- rowSums((subsample_mat %*% fish_mat)>0)
      return(sp)
    }
  ) %>% 
    list_c()
}

mf_sp_pi <- function(Spec,nT,Q0_hat){
  Sobs <- sum(Spec > 0)
  Q0_int <- ceiling(Q0_hat)
  Q1 <- sum(Spec == 1)
  Q2 <- sum(Spec == 2)
  A <- ifelse(Q1 > 0, nT * Q0_hat/(nT * Q0_hat + Q1), 1)
  a <- Q1/nT * A
  b <- sum(Spec/nT * (1 - Spec/nT)^nT)
  if (Q0_hat == 0) {
    w <- 0
    if (Sobs == 1) {
      warning("This site has only one species. Estimation is not robust.")
    }
  }
  else {
    w <- a/b
  }
  Prob_hat <- Spec/nT * (1 - w * (1 - Spec/nT)^nT)
  Prob_hat_Unse <- rep(a/Q0_int, Q0_int)
  Prob_hat_Unse <- setNames(
    Prob_hat_Unse,
    paste0("unkown_species",seq.int(Sobs+1,Sobs+Q0_int))
  )
  return(c(Prob_hat, Prob_hat_Unse))
}

mf_bc_ci <- function(x, theta_hat, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  z0 <- qnorm(mean(x<theta_hat))
  adj <- pnorm(2*z0 + qnorm(probs))
  quantile(x, adj)
}
```

```{r}
fish_info <- read_csv(

```

Read tracking in metabarcoding data processing
```{r}
read_track <- list.files(
  "./input/sequence/01_merged/", 
  pattern = ".txt", 
  full.names = T
) %>% 
  map(
    ~read_lines(.x) %>% 
      str_subset("\\s+\\d+\\s+Pairs|\\s+\\d+\\s+Merged") %>% 
      str_extract("(\\d+).*\\(",1) %>% 
      as.numeric()
  ) %>% 
  reduce(`+`) %>% 
  set_names("total","merged")

read_track["filtered"] <- list.files(
  "./input/sequence/03_filtered", 
  pattern = ".txt", 
  full.names = T
) %>% 
  map_dbl(
    ~read_lines(.x) %>% 
      str_subset("^\\s+\\d+\\s+Filtered reads \\(") %>% 
      str_extract("^\\s+(\\d+)\\s+Filtered reads",1) %>% 
      as.numeric()
  ) %>% 
  sum()

read_track[c("zotu","zotu_read")] <- read_csv(
  "./input/sequence/Zotu_seq_table.csv",
  col_select = -c(1,2),
  show_col_types = F
) %>% 
  summarise(zotu=n(),zotu_read=sum(.)) %>% 
  unlist()

read_track["fish"] <- fish_table %>% ncol()

read_track["fishread_all"] <- fish_table %>% sum()

fish_table <- fish_table %>% 
  filter(
    rownames(.) %in% pull(
      sample_info %>% filter(type=="sample"),
      exp_id
    )
  )

read_track["fishread_without_nc"] <- fish_table %>% sum()

read_track["contami_ratio"] <- (
  read_track["fishread_all"]-read_track["fishread_without_nc"]
)/
  sum(sample_info$type!="sample")/
  (
    read_track["fishread_without_nc"]/
      sum(sample_info$type=="sample")
  )
```

## w01_read
Rarefaction curve based on sample reads
```{r}
w01_read <- list()

w01_read$dat <- fish_table %>% 
  rarecurve(step=100,tidy=T)

w01_read$fig <- ggplot(
  data=w01_read$dat,
  aes(x=Sample,y=Species,col=Site)
)+
  geom_line(linewidth=0.3,alpha=0.5)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text=element_text(family = "serif")
  )+
  xlab("Reads")+
  ylab("Richness")

```

Data cleaning of fish community
```{r}
read_track["sample_drop"] <- sum(rowSums(fish_table)<15000)
fish_table <- fish_table %>% 
  filter(rowSums(.)>=15000) %>% 
  mfc()

sample_info <- sample_info %>% 
  filter(exp_id%in%rownames(fish_table))
```

Sequencing yielded a total of `r mfd(read_track["total"])` raw reads. Assembly produced `r mfd(read_track["merged"])` reads (`r mff(read_track["merged"]/read_track["total"])`%). Quality filtering resulted in `r mfd(read_track["filtered"])` reads (`r mff(read_track["filtered"]/read_track["total"])`%). Denoising yielded `r mfd(read_track["zotu"])` ZOTUs, with a total of `r mfd(read_track["zotu_read"])` reads (`r mff(read_track["zotu_read"]/read_track["total"])`%) matched to ZOTUs. All ZOTUs were classified and identified based on the Mitofish database, and reads from the same fish species in the same sample were merged. A total of `r mfd(read_track["fish"])` fish taxa were identified, with a total of `r mfd(read_track["fishread_all"])` reads (`r mff(read_track["fishread_all"]/read_track["total"])`%), of which `r mfd(read_track["fishread_without_nc"])` reads originated from the samples (`r mff(read_track["fishread_without_nc"]/read_track["fishread_all"])`%), and `r mfd(read_track["fishread_all"]-read_track["fishread_without_nc"])` reads originated from the negative control (`r mff((read_track["fishread_all"]-read_track["fishread_without_nc"])/read_track["fishread_all"])`%). Contamination accounted for a small proportion, and no further processing was performed on the negative control. Rarefaction curve based on sample reads revealed that most of the sample sequencing reads had approached the plateau phase, and `r read_track["sample_drop"]` samples with less than 15,000  reads were excluded.

Calculate the proportion of non-native species
```{r}

sample_info <- fish_table %>% 
  decostand(method="total") %>% 
  select(any_of(filter(fish_info,non_native==TRUE)$species_ns)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  enframe(name="exp_id",value="non_native_ratio") %>% 
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% 
      select(-any_of("non_native_ratio")),
    by="exp_id"
  )
```

```{r}
  "./output/Figure_S1_boxplot_of_non_native.svg",

figs1
```

A sample was found to have an extremely high proportion of non-native fish (`r mff(max(sample_info$non_native_ratio))`%), and was subsequently excluded.
```{r}
sample_info <- sample_info %>% 
  filter(non_native_ratio<0.9) %>% 
  mutate(
    grp_nn=ntile(non_native_ratio,5),
    grp_nn=factor(grp_nn,levels=1:5)
  )
fish_table <- fish_table %>% 
  filter(rownames(.)%in%sample_info$exp_id) %>% 
  mfc()
read_track["final"] <- sum(fish_table)
```
Ultimately, `r nrow(fish_table)` samples were retained, encompassing `r ncol(fish_table)` fish taxa, and downstream analysis was conducted based on this data.

Add human footprint data to sample information
```{r}
sample_info <- fish_table %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  enframe(name="exp_id",value = "total_reads") %>% 
  right_join(
    sample_info %>% select(-any_of("total_reads")),
    by="exp_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    hfp= sample_info %>% 
      st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude","latitude"),crs=4326) %>% 
      st_transform(crs=32651) %>% 
      st_buffer(dist=1000) %>% 
      st_transform(crs = crs(w02_map$hfp)) %>% 
      vect() %>% 
      {terra::extract(w02_map$hfp,.,fun=mean,na.rm=T)} %>% 
      pull(hfp2024)
  )
```

## w03_pca_env
Principal component analysis of environmental factors
```{r}
w03_pca_env <- list()

w03_pca_env$pca <- sample_info %>% 
  select(exp_id,hfp,wt,ph,do,salinity,turbidity) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("exp_id") %>% 
  rda(scale=T)

w03_pca_env$smry <- w03_pca_env$pca %>% summary()
w03_pca_env$score <- map(
  0:2,
  function(i){
    scores(w03_pca_env$pca,scaling=i,tidy=T) %>% 
      split(~score) %>% 
      modify_at(
        "sites",
        ~left_join(
          .,
          select(sample_info,exp_id,habitat,season),
          by = join_by(label==exp_id)
        )
      )
  }
) %>% 
  set_names(str_c("scaling",0:2))

w03_pca_env <- c(
  w03_pca_env[1:3],
  map(
    0:2,
    function(i){
      sc <- str_c("scaling",i)
      ggplot()+
        geom_point(
          data=w03_pca_env$score[[sc]]$sites,
          aes(x=PC1,y=PC2,shape=habitat,fill=season),
          size=2,alpha=0.5,col="black"
        )+
        scale_shape_manual(
          values = c("river" = 21, "reservoir" = 24, "tidal" = 22)
        )+
        geom_segment(
          data=w03_pca_env$score[[sc]]$species,
          aes(x=0,y=0,xend=PC1,yend=PC2),
          arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.03, "npc")), 
          alpha = 0.5
        )+
        geom_text(
          data=w03_pca_env$score[[sc]]$species,
          aes(
            x=PC1,y=PC2,hjust = "inward", vjust = "outward",
            label = case_when(
              label == "hfp" ~ "Human footprint",
              label == "do" ~ "Do",
              label == "longitude" ~ "Longitude",
              label == "ph" ~ "pH",
              label == "turbidity" ~ "Turbidity",
              label == "wt" ~ "Water temperature",
              label == "salinity" ~ "Salinity",
              .default = label
            )
          ),
          family="serif"
        )+
        labs(
          x = paste0(
            "PC1(",
            mff(w03_pca_env$smry$cont[[1]][2,1]),
            "%)"
          ),
          y = paste0(
            "PC2(",
            mff(w03_pca_env$smry$cont[[1]][2,2]),
            "%)"
          ),
          shape="Habitat",
          fill="Season"
        )+
        guides(
          fill = guide_legend(
            override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2)
          )
        )+
        theme_bw()+
        theme(
          text=element_text(family = "serif"),
          legend.position = c(0.99, 0.01),
          legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
          legend.spacing = unit(-0.2, "cm"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm")
        )
    }
  ) %>% 
    set_names(str_c("fig_scaling",0:2))
)
```

## w04_tree
Construct a phylogenetic tree of fish
```{r}
#| output: false

w04_tree <- list()

w04_tree$syn <- tibble(
  x = c(
    "Planiliza haematocheilus",
    "Planiliza lauvergnii",
    "Coptodon zillii",
    "Odontobutis potamophilus",
    "Misgurnus dabryanus",
    "Tachysurus dumerili"
  ),
  y = c(
    "Mugil soiuy",
    "Liza affinis",
    "Tilapia zillii",
    "Odontobutis potamophila",
    "Paramisgurnus dabryanus",
    "Leiocassis longirostris"
  )
)

w04_tree$tree <- fish_info %>% 
  mutate(
    species_lt = mf_change_str(species_lt,w04_tree$syn,2)
  ) %>% 
  pull(species_lt) %>% 
  sp_list_df(taxon = "fish") %>% 
  get_tree(
    taxon = "fish",
    scenario = "at_basal_node",
    show_grafted = T
  ) %>% 
  modify_at("tip.label",~str_replace(.x,"_"," ")) %>% 
  modify_at("tip.label",~mf_change_str(.x,w04_tree$syn,1))

w04_tree$tree_without_stars <- w04_tree$tree %>% 
  rm_stars() %>% 
  modify_at("tip.label",~str_replace(.x," ","_"))

w04_tree$tree_dis <- w04_tree$tree_without_stars %>% 
  cophenetic()

w04_tree$node_order <- fish_info %>% 
  group_by(order) %>% 
  summarise(
    sp_n=n(),
    node=ifelse(
      n()>1,
      getMRCA(w04_tree$tree_without_stars,species_ns),
      which(w04_tree$tree_without_stars$tip.label == species_ns)
    )
  )

w04_tree$node_sp <- w04_tree$tree_without_stars$tip.label %>% 
  as_tibble_col("species_ns") %>% 
  mutate(
    node=row_number()
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    fish_info %>% select(species_ns,non_native),
    by="species_ns"
  ) %>% 
  select(!species_ns)

w04_tree$dat_tree <- ggtree(w04_tree$tree)$data %>% 
  as_tibble()

w04_tree$fish_lvl <- w04_tree$dat_tree %>% 
  select(label,y,isTip) %>% 
  filter(isTip==T) %>% 
  mutate(label=str_remove_all(label,"\\*")) %>% 
  arrange(y)
```

## w05_domi
Calculate and plot dominance
```{r}

w05_domi <- fish_table %>% 
  decostand(method="total") %>% 
  mf_cal_domi() %>% 
  mutate(species=str_replace(species,"_"," ")) %>% 
  left_join(
    select(fish_info,species_lt,non_native),
    by=join_by(species==species_lt)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(-domi) %>% 
  list(domi_all=.)

w05_domi$fig_domi_all_v <- w05_domi$domi_all %>%
```

## w06_distribution
Distribution of non-native fish species
```{r}
w06_distribution <- list()

w06_distribution$mod_base <- gam(
  data=sample_info,
  non_native_ratio~s(ph)+
    s(do)+
    te(longitude,latitude)+
    habitat+
    season+
    salinity+
    turbidity+
    log(filtration_volume)+
    s(site,bs="re"),
  weights=total_reads,
  family=quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
  method="REML",
  select = T
)

w06_distribution$mod_full <- gam(
  data=sample_info,
  non_native_ratio~s(hfp)+
    s(ph)+
    s(do)+
    te(longitude,latitude)+
    habitat+
    season+
    salinity+
    turbidity+
    log(filtration_volume)+
    s(site,bs="re"),
  weights=total_reads,
  family=quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
  method="REML",
  select = T
)

anova(
  w06_distribution$mod_base, 
  w06_distribution$mod_full, 
  test="F"
)

w06_distribution$smry_tab_p <- w06_distribution$mod_full %>% 
  summary() %>% 
  .[["p.table"]] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Terms")

w06_distribution$smry_tab_s <- w06_distribution$mod_full %>% 
  summary() %>% 
  .[["s.table"]] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Terms") %>% 
  mutate(
    p_lab=case_when(
      `p-value`<0.001 ~ "p < 0.001***",
      `p-value`<0.01  ~ sprintf("p = %.3f**",`p-value`),
      `p-value`<0.05  ~ sprintf("p = %.3f*", `p-value`),
      .default = sprintf("p = %.3f", `p-value`)
    )
  )

w06_distribution$dat_fit <- tibble(
  hfp=seq(min(sample_info$hfp),max(sample_info$hfp),length=100),
  ph=seq(min(sample_info$ph),max(sample_info$ph),length=100),
  do=0,
  habitat="river",
  season="Summer",
  longitude=0,
  latitude=0,
  salinity=0,
  turbidity=0,
  filtration_volume=0,
  site=as.factor("1"),
  total_reads=0
) %>% 
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      w06_distribution$mod_full,
      newdata=.,
      type="terms",
      terms=c("s(hfp)","s(ph)"),
      se.fit=T
    ) %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      rename_with(~{
        .x %>% 
          str_replace("^fit\\.s\\.","fit_") %>% 
          str_replace("^se\\.fit\\.s\\.","se_") %>% 
          str_remove_all("\\.")
      })
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit_hfp, fit_ph, se_hfp, se_ph),
    names_to = c(".value", "terms"),
    names_pattern = "(fit|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    x = case_when(
      terms == "hfp" ~ hfp,
      terms == "ph"  ~ ph
    )
  )

w06_distribution$dat_resi <- sample_info %>% 
  mutate(resi=residuals(w06_distribution$mod_full,type="working")) %>% 
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      w06_distribution$mod_full,
      newdata=.,
      type="terms",
      terms=c("s(hfp)","s(ph)"),
      se.fit=T
    ) %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      rename_with(~{
        .x %>% 
          str_replace("^fit\\.s\\.","fit_") %>% 
          str_replace("^se\\.fit\\.s\\.","se_") %>% 
          str_remove_all("\\.")
      })
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit_hfp, fit_ph, se_hfp, se_ph),
    names_to = c(".value", "terms"),
    names_pattern = "(fit|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    x = case_when(
      terms == "hfp" ~ hfp,
      terms == "ph"  ~ ph
    ),
    fit_resi=fit+resi
  )

w06_distribution$fig_fit <- ggplot(w06_distribution$dat_fit)+
  facet_wrap(
    terms~.,
    ncol=1,scale="free",
    labeller = labeller(
      terms=c(
        hfp = "Human Footprint",
        ph  = "pH"
      )
    )
  )+
  geom_line(aes(x=x,y=fit),linewidth=0.75,col="blue")+
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(x=x,ymin=fit-1.96*se,ymax=fit+1.96*se),
    alpha=0.25
  )+
  geom_point(
    data=w06_distribution$dat_resi %>% filter(fit_resi<=4),
    aes(x=x,y=fit_resi),
    alpha=0.5
  )+
  geom_text(
    data=w06_distribution$smry_tab_s %>% 
      filter(Terms %in% c("s(hfp)","s(ph)")) %>% 
      mutate(terms=str_extract(Terms,"\\((.+)\\)",1)),
    aes(x=-Inf,y=Inf,label = p_lab),
    hjust=-0.1,vjust=1.5,
    family="serif",size=5
  )+
  labs(
    x=NULL,
    y="Partial effect on proportion of non-native fish species (logit)"
  )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    text=element_text(family="serif",size=15)
  )

w06_distribution$figdat_boxplot <- sample_info %>% 
  mutate(
    resi=residuals(w06_distribution$mod_full,type="working")
  ) %>% 
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      w06_distribution$mod_full,
      newdata=.,
      type="terms",
      terms=c("habitat","season"),
      se.fit=T
    ) %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      rename_with(~{
        .x %>% 
          str_replace("^fit\\.","fit_") %>% 
          str_replace("^se\\.fit\\.","se_")
      })
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit_habitat,fit_season,se_habitat,se_season),
    names_to = c(".value", "terms"),
    names_pattern = "(fit|se)_(.*)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    x = case_when(
      terms == "habitat" ~ habitat,
      terms == "season"  ~ season
    ),
    fit_resi=fit+resi,
    terms=factor(terms,levels=c("season","habitat"))
  )

w06_distribution$figdat_cld <- c(
  season="season",
  habitat="habitat"
) %>% 
  map(
    ~emmeans::emmeans(
      w06_distribution$mod_full, 
      reformulate(.x),
      data=sample_info
    )
  ) %>% 
  map(pairs) %>% 
  map(summary) %>% 
  map(
    ~set_names(.x$p.value,str_replace_all(.x$contrast," ",""))
  ) %>% 
  map(multcompView::multcompLetters) %>% 
  map("Letters") %>% 
  map(~enframe(.x,name="x",value="cld")) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to="terms") %>% 
  left_join(
    w06_distribution$figdat_boxplot %>% 
      summarise(y=1.1*max(fit_resi),.by=terms),
    by="terms"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    terms=factor(terms,levels=c("season","habitat")),
  )

w06_distribution$fig_boxplot <- ggplot(w06_distribution$figdat_boxplot)+
  facet_wrap(
    ~terms,ncol=1,scales="free",
    labeller=labeller(
      terms=c(
        season="Season",
        habitat="Habitat"
      )
    )
  )+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=x,y=fit_resi))+
  geom_text(
    data=w06_distribution$figdat_cld,
    aes(x=x,y=y,label=cld),
    family="serif",size=5
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_to_sentence(x))+
  labs(
    x=NULL,
    y="Partial effect on proportion of non-native fish species (logit)"
  )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    text=element_text(family="serif",size=15)
  )
```

## w07_src
Area-Intensity separated species rarefaction surface (AISRS)

Stability of parameter estimation under subsamples with different sample sizes
```{r}
#| eval: false

w07_src <- list()

w07_src$fish_mat <- fish_table %>% 
  decostand("pa") %>% 
  as.matrix()

w07_src$sample_coord <- sample_info %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude","latitude"),crs=4326) %>% 
  st_transform(crs=32651) %>% 
  st_coordinates()

set.seed(202602)
plan(multisession, workers = availableCores() - 1)
w07_src$dat_cv <- future_map(
  seq_len(100),
  function(k){
    sub_idx <- mf_get_idx(
          w07_src$sample_coord,
          sub_rep = 2000,
          seed=k
        )
    dat_sub <- mf_cal_area(
          w07_src$sample_coord,
          sub_idx,
          buf = 1000
        ) %>% 
          mutate(
            sp=mf_cal_sp(w07_src$fish_mat,sub_idx)
          ) %>% 
      group_by(sample_n)
    map(
      c(
        10,20,40,60,80,
        100,150,200,250,300,350,400,450,
        500,750,1000,1500,2000
      ),
      function(i){
        
        dat_sub_i <- dat_sub %>% 
          slice_head(n=i)
        
        mod_nls <- tryCatch(
          nlsLM(
            data=dat_sub_i,
            sp~a*sample_area^b*intensity^c/(d^c+intensity^c),
            start=list(a=15,b=0.28,c=0.6,d=0.007)
          ),
          error = function(e){NULL},
          warning = function(w){NULL}
        )
        
        if(is.null(mod_nls)){
          return(c(a=NA,b=NA,c=NA,d=NA,sub_rep=i))
        }else{
          return(c(coef(mod_nls),sub_rep=i))
        }
      }
    ) %>% 
      bind_rows()
  },
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
) %>% 
  list_rbind() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(a)) %>% 
  group_by(sub_rep) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(c(a,b,c,d),~sd(.x)/mean(.x)),
    mod_rep=n()
  )
plan(sequential)

w07_src$fig_cv <- w07_src$dat_cv %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    a:d,
    names_to = "para",
    values_to = "cv"
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sub_rep,y=cv,col=para))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01,col="red",linetype=2)+
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = Inf, y = 0.01, 
    label = "1.0%",
    col = "red", size=5,family="serif",
    hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5
  )+
  labs(
    x="Subsampling times",
    y="Coefficient of Variation",
    col=NULL
  )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    text = element_text(size=15,family="serif"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c("right","top")
  )
```

Interval estimation
```{r}
#| eval: false

w07_src$est_interval$fish_pi <- mf_sp_pi(
  colSums(w07_src$fish_mat),
  nrow(w07_src$fish_mat),
  w07_src$est_point$para[["a"]]*
    max(w07_src[["est_point"]][["dat_orig_sub"]]$sample_area)^
    w07_src$est_point$para[["b"]]-
    ncol(w07_src$fish_mat)
)

w07_src$est_interval$fish_site_weight <- w07_src$fish_mat %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  map(
    function(i){
      df <- tibble(y = i, w07_src$sample_coord %>% as_tibble())
      gam(
        data=df,
        y~te(X,Y),
        family=binomial,
        method="REML"
      ) %>%
        fitted()
    }
  ) %>%
  bind_cols()

set.seed(202604)
plan(multisession, workers = availableCores() - 1L)
w07_src$est_interval$para <- future_map(
  seq_len(2222L),
  function(i){
    n_sample <- nrow(w07_src$fish_mat)
    n_fish_obs <- ncol(w07_src$fish_mat)
    n_fish <- length(w07_src$est_interval$fish_pi)

    obs_boot <- rbinom(n_fish,n_sample,w07_src$est_interval$fish_pi)
    
    fish_mat_boot <- matrix(0L,n_sample,n_fish)
    for(j in seq_len(n_fish)){
      idx <- sample.int(
        n_sample,
        obs_boot[j],
        replace = F,
        prob = if(j<=n_fish_obs){
          w07_src$est_interval$fish_site_weight %>% 
            as_tibble %>% 
            pull(j)
        }else{
          w07_src$est_interval$fish_site_weight %>% 
            as_tibble %>% 
            pull(sample(n_fish_obs,1))
        }
      )
      fish_mat_boot[idx, j] <- 1L
    }

    dat_boot_sub <- w07_src$est_point$dat_orig_sub %>% 
      mutate(
        sp=mf_cal_sp(fish_mat_boot,w07_src$est_point$idx)
      )
    
    mod_nls_boot <- tryCatch(
      nlsLM(
        data=dat_boot_sub,
        sp~a*sample_area^b*intensity^c/(d^c+intensity^c),
        start=list(a=15,b=0.28,c=0.6,d=0.007)
      ),
      error = function(e){NULL},
      warning = function(w){NULL}
    )
    
    if(is.null(mod_nls_boot)){
      return(c(a=NA,b=NA,c=NA,d=NA))
    }else{
      return(coef(mod_nls_boot))
    }
  },
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
) %>% 
  bind_rows()
plan(sequential)

saveRDS(
  w07_src,
  "./mid/w07_src.rds"
)
```

The model is shown as follows:

$$
S = `r round(a,3)` \cdot Area^{`r round(b,3)`} \cdot \frac{Intensity^{`r round(c,3)`}}{`r round(d,4)`^{`r round(c,3)`} + Intensity^{`r round(c,3)`}}
$$

Calculate sample-based rarefaction curves by AISRS
```{r}
w07_src$dat_src <- w07_src[["est_point"]][["dat_orig_sub"]] %>% 
  summarise(
    sample_area=mean(sample_area),
    .by=sample_n
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      sample_n=(nrow(fish_table)+1):(nrow(fish_table)*3),
      sample_area=max_area
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    intensity=sample_n/sample_area,
    richness=a*sample_area^b*intensity^c/(d^c+intensity^c)
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    lw=mf_bc_ci(
      a_itvl*sample_area^b_itvl*
        intensity^c_itvl/(d_itvl^c_itvl+intensity^c_itvl),
      richness,
      0.025
    ),
    up=mf_bc_ci(
      a_itvl*sample_area^b_itvl*
        intensity^c_itvl/(d_itvl^c_itvl+intensity^c_itvl),
      richness,
      0.975
    ),
    type="AISRS"
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(sample=sample_n) %>% 
  select(!c(sample_area,intensity)) %>% 
  bind_rows(w07_src$dat_src %>% filter(type!="AISRS"))
```

Estimate the extrapolated species richness
```{r}
w07_src$sp_pool <- fish_table %>% 
  decostand("pa") %>% 
  specpool() %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  select(-n) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Species,
    names_to = c("index", "stat"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*?)\\.?(se)?$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(stat = if_else(stat=="","est",stat)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>% 
  mutate(
    D   = est - Species,
    R   = exp(1.96 * sqrt(log(1 + se^2 / D^2))),
    ll  = Species + D / R,
    ul  = Species + D * R,
    lab = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f - %.1f)",est,ll,ul)
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(D,R,ll,ul))
```

Calculate the sampling intensity required to reach a specific detection threshold using AISRS.
```{r}
w07_src$dat_intensity <- tibble(
  intensity=seq(0,2,length=1000),
) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    fit_poit=intensity^c/(d^c+intensity^c),
    lw=mf_bc_ci(
      intensity^c_itvl/(d_itvl^c_itvl+intensity^c_itvl),
      fit_poit,
      0.025
    ),
    up=mf_bc_ci(
      intensity^c_itvl/(d_itvl^c_itvl+intensity^c_itvl),
      fit_poit,
      0.975
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

w07_src$dat_threshold <- tibble(
  threshold=c(0.50,0.85,0.90,0.95),
  intensity=d*(threshold/(1-threshold))^(1/c),
  lab=sprintf("(%.3f, %.0f%%)",intensity,threshold*100)
) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    lw=mf_bc_ci(
      d_itvl*(threshold/(1-threshold))^(1/c_itvl),
      intensity,
      0.025
    ),
    up=mf_bc_ci(
      d_itvl*(threshold/(1-threshold))^(1/c_itvl),
      intensity,
      0.975
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

w07_src$fig_intensity <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(
    data=w07_src$dat_intensity,
    aes(
      x=intensity,
      y=fit_poit,
      linetype = intensity > nrow(sample_info)/max_area
    )
  )+
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = 1, "TRUE" = 2),
    name   = NULL,
    labels = c(
      "FALSE" = "Samples",
      "TRUE"  = "Extrapolation"
    )
  )+
  geom_ribbon(
    data=w07_src$dat_intensity,
    aes(
      x=intensity,
      ymin=lw,
      ymax=up
    ),
    alpha=0.15
  )+
  geom_point(
    data=w07_src$dat_threshold,
    aes(x=intensity,y=threshold),
    size=2
  )+
  geom_text_repel(
    data=w07_src$dat_threshold,
    aes(x=intensity,y=threshold,label=lab),
    size=3
  )+
  xlim(0,filter(w07_src$dat_threshold,threshold==0.95)$intensity * 1.1)+
  labs(
    x=expression(Sampling~intensity ~ (samples/km^2)),
    y="Detection rate"
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    text=element_text(family="serif",size=12),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.98,0.02),
    legend.justification.inside = c(1, 0)
  )
```

## w08_alpha
The five diversity indices, *S* (Species abundance), *H* (Shannon diversity), *J* (Evenness), *MPD* (Mean pairwise distance), and *MNTD* (Mean nearest taxon distance), were calculated on the datasets that included all fish species (All) and those that only contained native fish species (Native).
```{r}
#| eval: false

set.seed(202605)
w08_alpha <- list()
w08_alpha$alpha_div <- list(
  All=fish_table,
  Native=fish_table %>% 
    select(
      any_of(
        filter(fish_info,non_native==FALSE)$species_ns
      )
    )
) %>% 
  map(~decostand(.x,method="total")) %>% 
  map(
    ~tibble(
      exp_id=rownames(.x),
      S=specnumber(.x),
      H=diversity(.x,index="shannon"),
      J=H/log(S),
      MPD=ses.mpd(
        .x,w04_tree$tree_dis,abundance.weighted=T
      )$mpd.obs.z,
      MNTD=ses.mntd(
        .x,w04_tree$tree_dis,abundance.weighted=T
      )$mntd.obs.z
    )
  ) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "sp_range") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols=S:MNTD,
    names_to="index",
    values_to = "values"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    index=factor(
      index,levels=c("S","H","J","MPD","MNTD")
    ),
    sp_range=factor(sp_range,levels=c("All","Native"))
  ) %>% 
  arrange(index,sp_range) %>% 
  left_join(sample_info %>% select(-type),by="exp_id")
```

On the All and Native datasets, GAMs were established respectively using five diversity indicators as response variables.
```{r}
#| eval: false

w08_alpha$families <- list(
  S    = nb(link = "log"),
  H    = Gamma(link = "log"),
  J    = betar(link = "logit"),
  MPD  = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  MNTD = gaussian(link = "identity")
)

w08_alpha$gam <- w08_alpha$alpha_div %>% 
  split(~sp_range+index) %>% 
  imap(
    ~gam(
      data = .x,
      family = w08_alpha$families[[str_extract(
        .y, "(S|H|J|MPD|MNTD)$"
      )]],
      formula = values~s(non_native_ratio)+
        s(hfp)+
        s(ph)+
        s(do)+
        te(longitude,latitude)+
        habitat+
        season+
        salinity+
        turbidity+
        log(filtration_volume)+
        log(total_reads)+
        s(site,bs="re"),
      method = "REML",
      select = T
    )
  )

saveRDS(
  w08_alpha,
  "./mid/w08_alpha.rds"
)
```

Prepare the data for drawing.
```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide

w08_alpha <- readRDS("./mid/w08_alpha.rds")

w08_alpha$ptresi <- w08_alpha$gam %>% 
  imap(
    function(i,j){
      f_plotgam <- plot.gam(i,select = 0,residuals = T,se=1.96)
      f_fit <- tibble(
        x = f_plotgam[[1]]$x,
        y = f_plotgam[[1]]$fit[,1],
        se = f_plotgam[[1]]$se,
        index = str_extract(j,"\\.(.*)",1),
        sp_range = str_extract(j,"(.*)\\.",1)
      )
      f_raw <- tibble(
        x = f_plotgam[[1]]$raw,
        y = residuals(i,type="working")+
          predict(i,type="terms",terms="s(non_native_ratio)")[,1],
        index = str_extract(j,"\\.(.*)",1),
        sp_range = str_extract(j,"(.*)\\.",1)
      )
      f_smry_tab_p <- summary(i)[["p.table"]] %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("term") %>% 
        mutate(
          index = str_extract(j,"\\.(.*)",1),
          sp_range = str_extract(j,"(.*)\\.",1)
        )
      f_smry_tab_s <- summary(i)[["s.table"]] %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("term") %>% 
        mutate(
          index = str_extract(j,"\\.(.*)",1),
          sp_range = str_extract(j,"(.*)\\.",1)
        )
      return(
        list(
          fit=f_fit,
          raw=f_raw,
          smry_tab_p=f_smry_tab_p,
          smry_tab_s=f_smry_tab_s
        )
      )
    }
  ) %>% 
  list_transpose() %>% 
  map(bind_rows) %>% 
  map(
    ~mutate(
      .x,
      index=factor(
        index,
        levels=c("S","H","J","MPD","MNTD")
      ),
      sp_range=factor(sp_range,levels=c("All","Native"))
    )
  ) %>% 
  modify_at(
    "smry_tab_s",
    ~select(.x,!`p-value`,`p-value`)
  )
```

### Figure 5
```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 5"
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 12

fig5 <- ggplot(
  data=w08_alpha$ptresi$fit,
  aes(x=x,y=y)
)+
  facet_grid(index~.,scales="free_y")+
  geom_line(aes(col=sp_range))+
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x=x,
      ymin=y-se,
      ymax=y+se,
      group=sp_range
    ),
    alpha=0.15
  )+
  geom_point(
    data=w08_alpha$ptresi$raw %>% filter(y >= -1.5),
    aes(x=x,y=y,col=sp_range),
    alpha=0.65,size=0.5
  )+
  geom_text(
    data=w08_alpha$ptresi$smry_tab_s %>% 
      left_join(
        w08_alpha$ptresi$raw %>% 
          filter(y >= -1.5) %>% 
          group_by(index) %>% 
          summarise(y_max=max(y),y_diff=diff(range(y))),
        by="index"
      ) %>% 
      filter(
        term=="s(non_native_ratio)"
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        # p_lab=round(`p-value`,3),
        p_lab=case_when(
          `p-value`<0.001 ~ "p<0.001***",
          `p-value`<0.01  ~ sprintf("p=%.3f**",`p-value`),
          `p-value`<0.05  ~ sprintf("p=%.3f*", `p-value`),
          .default = sprintf("p=%.3f", `p-value`)
        ),
        p_y=y_max-y_diff*0.08*(as.numeric(sp_range)-1)
      ),
    aes(x=0.7,y=p_y,label=p_lab,col=sp_range),
    hjust=0,
    show.legend = F
  )+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    text=element_text(size=15,family = "serif"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")
  )+
  labs(
    x="proportion of non-native fish species",
    y="Component smooth function"
  )

ggsave(
  "./output/Figure_5_gam_component_smooth.svg",
  fig5,
  width = 6,height = 12,device = svglite
)

fig5
```

Diagnosis of GAMs
```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide

w08_alpha$check <- w08_alpha$gam %>% 
  imap(
    function(i,j){
      capture.output(gam.check(i))[13:18] %>% 
        str_split("\\s+") %>% 
        do.call(rbind,.) %>% .[,-6] %>% 
        as_tibble(
          .name_repair=~c("term","k'","edf","k-index","p-value")
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          across(everything(), ~na_if(., "NA")),
          
          index = str_extract(j,"\\.(.*)",1),
          sp_range = str_extract(j,"(.*)\\.",1)
        )
    }
  ) %>% 
  list_rbind() %>% 
  mutate(
    `p-value` = case_when(
      `p-value`<=0.001 ~ str_c(`p-value`,"***"),
      `p-value`<=0.01 ~ str_c(`p-value`,"**"),
      `p-value`<=0.05 ~ str_c(`p-value`,"*"),
      .default = `p-value`
    )
  )
```

## w09_assem
```{r}
#| eval: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

set.seed(202606)
w09_assem <- list()

w09_assem$dat <- expand.grid(
  sp_range=c("All","Native"),
  weight=c(T,F)
) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    fish_table2=ifelse(
      sp_range=="All",
      list(fish_table %>% decostand("total")),
      list(
        fish_table %>% 
          select(
            any_of(
              filter(fish_info,non_native==FALSE)$species_ns
            )
          ) %>% 
          mfc() %>% 
          decostand("total")
      )
    ),
    tree_dis=list(
      w04_tree$tree_without_stars %>% 
        keep.tip(colnames(fish_table2)) %>% 
        cophenetic()
    ),
    assem=list(
      list(
        bNRI = bNRIn.p(
          comm = fish_table2,
          dis = tree_dis,
          weighted = weight,
          rand = 999,
          nworker = 4,
          sig.index = "SES",
          output.bMPD = T
        ),
        bNTI = bNTIn.p(
          comm = fish_table2,
          dis = tree_dis,
          weighted = weight,
          rand = 999,
          nworker = 4,
          sig.index = "SES",
          output.bMNTD = T
        ),
        RCbray = RC.pc(
          comm = fish_table2,
          rand = 999,
          nworker = 4,
          weighted = weight,
          sig.index = "RC",
          output.bray = T
        )
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(fish_table2,tree_dis)) %>% 
  unnest_longer(assem,indices_to = "index") %>% 
  unnest_longer(assem,indices_to = "type",values_to = "dis") %>% 
  filter(type!="sig.index") %>% 
  mutate(
    type=ifelse(type=="index","ses","obs")
  )
```

MRM
```{r}
#| eval: false

w09_assem$var <- list(
  non_native_ratio_dis=dist(sample_info$non_native_ratio),
  geo_dis=dist(sample_info %>% select(longitude,latitude)),
  env_dis=sample_info %>% 
    select(hfp,ph,do,salinity,turbidity,habitat,season) %>% 
    cluster::daisy(metric = "gower"),
  exp_dis=sample_info %>% 
    select(filtration_volume,total_reads) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(),~log(.))) %>% 
    dist()
) %>% 
  c(
    sample_info %>% 
      select(
        non_native_ratio,hfp,longitude,latitude,ph,do,
        salinity,turbidity,wt,filtration_volume,total_reads
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        filtration_volume=log(filtration_volume),
        total_reads=log(total_reads)
      ) %>% 
      map(~as.dist(outer(.x,.x,`+`)/2)) %>% 
      set_names(~str_c(.x,"_mean"))
  )

w09_assem$dat <- w09_assem$dat %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    mrm=list(
      MRM(
        data=c(list(y=as.dist(dis)),w09_assem$var),
        y~non_native_ratio_dis+
          env_dis+
          geo_dis+
          exp_dis+
          non_native_ratio_mean+
          hfp_mean+
          ph_mean+
          do_mean+
          salinity_mean+
          turbidity_mean+
          wt_mean+
          longitude_mean+
          latitude_mean+
          filtration_volume_mean+
          total_reads_mean
      )
    )
  )

saveRDS(
  w09_assem,
  "./mid/w09_assem.rds"
)
```

figdat_βNRI,βNTI,RCbray
```{r}

w09_assem <- readRDS("./mid/w09_assem.rds")

w09_assem$grp_nn_lab <- sample_info %>% 
  group_by(grp_nn) %>% 
  summarise(
    label=sprintf(
      "%.1f~%.1f%%",
      min(non_native_ratio)*100,
      max(non_native_ratio)*100
    )
  ) %>% 
  pull(label)

w09_assem$figdat_ass <- w09_assem$dat %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  filter(type!="obs") %>%
  mutate(
    dis3col=list(dis %>% dist.3col())
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-c(dis,mrm)) %>% 
  unnest(dis3col) %>% 
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% select(exp_id,grp_nn),
    by=join_by(name1==exp_id)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% select(exp_id,grp_nn),
    by=join_by(name2==exp_id),
    suffix = c("","2")
  ) %>% 
  nest(figdata=!weight)

w09_assem$fig_density <- w09_assem$figdat_ass %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    fig=list(
      ggplot(figdata)+
        facet_grid(
          index~.,scale="free",switch = "y",
          labeller = labeller(
            index = c(
              bNRI = "βNRI",
              bNTI = "βNTI",
              RCbray = "RCbray"
            )
          )
        )+
        geom_density(
          aes(x=after_stat(scaled),y=dis,fill=sp_range),
          alpha=0.5,linewidth=0.25
        )+
        geom_hline(
          data=tibble(
            index=c(
              "bNRI","bNRI","bNTI","bNTI","RCbray","RCbray"
            ),
            yinter=c(1.96,-1.96,1.96,-1.96,0.95,-0.95)
          ),
          aes(yintercept = yinter),
          linetype=2,
          linewidth=0.25,
          color="red"
        )+
        geom_blank(
          data=figdata %>% 
            group_by(index) %>% 
            filter(dis==max(dis)|dis==min(dis)) %>% 
            ungroup(),
          aes(x=1,y=dis)
        )+
        scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(0,0.5,1))+
        theme_bw()+
        theme(
          text=element_text(family="serif",size=16),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank()
        )+
        labs(
          x="Scaled density",
          y=NULL,
          title = ifelse(
            weight,
            "A. Relative abundance weighting",
            "C. Unweighted"
          )
        )
    )

  select(weight,fig)

w09_assem$fig_boxplot <- w09_assem$figdat_ass %>%
```

```{r}
w09_assem$figdat_mrm <- w09_assem$dat %>%

    lm=list(

        data=c(
          list(y=as.dist(dis) %>% as.vector()),

          as_tibble(),
        y~non_native_ratio_dis+

          non_native_ratio_mean+
          hfp_mean+
          ph_mean+
          do_mean+
          salinity_mean+
          turbidity_mean+
          wt_mean+
          longitude_mean+
          latitude_mean+
          filtration_volume_mean+
          total_reads_mean
      )
    ),
    coe=coef(lm)[["non_native_ratio_mean"]],
    point=list(
      tibble(
        sp_range=sp_range,
        index=index,
        x=w09_assem$var$non_native_ratio_mean,
        y=residuals(lm)+x*coe
      )
    ),
    line=list(
      tibble(
        sp_range=sp_range,
        index=index,
        x=seq(
          min(w09_assem$var$non_native_ratio_mean),
          max(w09_assem$var$non_native_ratio_mean),
          length=10
        ),
        y=x*coe
      )
    ),
    text=list(
      tibble(
        sp_range=sp_range,
        index=index,
        p=mrm$coef["non_native_ratio_mean","pval"],
        p_lab=case_when(
          p<=0.001 ~ sprintf("coef=%.3f, p=%.3f***",coe,p),
          p<=0.01 ~ sprintf("coef=%.3f, p=%.3f**",coe,p),
          p<=0.05 ~ sprintf("coef=%.3f, p=%.3f*",coe,p),
          .default = sprintf("coef=%.3f, p=%.3f",coe,p)
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

Table data
```{r}
w09_assem$tab_mrm_smry <- w09_assem$dat %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    mrm_smry=list(
      mrm[["coef"]] %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("Terms")
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(sp_range,weight,index,type,mrm_smry) %>% 
  unnest(mrm_smry) %>% 
  rename(
    Estimate=y,
    P=pval
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    P=case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ str_c(P,"***"),
      P <= 0.01  ~ str_c(P,"**"),
      P <= 0.05  ~ str_c(P,"*"),
      .default = as.character(P)
    ),
    index=case_when(
      type=="obs" & index=="bNRI" ~ "βMPD",
      type=="obs" & index=="bNTI" ~ "βMNTD",
      type=="obs" & index=="RCbray" ~ "Bray-Curtis",
      .default = str_replace(index,"^b","β")
    )
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sp_range,
    values_from = c(Estimate,P)
  ) %>% 
  nest_by(weight,type) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    tab=list(
      data %>% 
        gt(
          groupname_col = "index",
          row_group_as_column=T
        ) %>% 
        tab_spanner(
          label="All fish species",
          columns=c(
            Estimate_All,P_All
          )
        ) %>% 
        tab_spanner(
          label="Native fish species",
          columns=c(
            Estimate_Native,P_Native
          )
        ) %>% 
        cols_label(
          Estimate_All="Estimate",
          P_All="P",
          Estimate_Native="Estimate",
          P_Native="P"
        ) %>% 
        fmt_scientific(
          columns = starts_with("Estimate"),
          decimals = 2
        ) %>% 
        tab_options(row_group.as_column = TRUE) 
    )
  )
```

## w10_nmds
Prepare data
```{r}

set.seed(202607)

w10_nmds <- list()

w10_nmds$nmds <- w09_assem$dat %>% 
  filter(type=="obs") %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(dis=list(as.dist(dis))) %>%
  select(sp_range,index,weight,dis) %>%
  mutate(
    nmds=list(
      metaMDS(dis,k=2,trymax=99,trace=0)
    ),
    adonis=list(
      adonis2(
        dis~non_native_ratio+
          hfp+ph+do+habitat+season+turbidity+salinity+
          longitude*latitude,
        data=sample_info,
        by="margin",
        permutation=999,
        add="cailliez"
      ) %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("Terms")
    ),
    betadis=list(
      betadisper(
        dis,
        sample_info$grp_nn,
        add="cailliez"
      ) 
    ),
    betadis_tukey=list(
      TukeyHSD(betadis)$group %>% 
        as.data.frame()
    )
  )
```

NMDS visualization
```{r}
w10_nmds$figdata_nmds <- w10_nmds$nmds %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    score_sample=list(
      scores(nmds,display="site") %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("exp_id") %>% 
        left_join(
          select(sample_info,exp_id,habitat,season,grp_nn),
          by="exp_id"
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          sp_range=sp_range,
          index=index
        ) %>% 
        group_by(sp_range,index) %>% 
        mutate(
          scale_max = max(abs(c(NMDS1, NMDS2))),
          NMDS1 = NMDS1/scale_max,
          NMDS2 = NMDS2/scale_max
        ) %>% 
        ungroup()
    ),
    stress_lab=list(
      tibble(
        sp_range=sp_range,
        index=index,
        stress_lab=sprintf("Stress = %.3f",nmds$stress)
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(weight) %>% 
  summarise(
    score_sample=list(list_rbind(score_sample)),
    stress_lab=list(list_rbind(stress_lab))
  )

w10_nmds$fig_nmds <- w10_nmds$figdata_nmds %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    fig=list(
      ggplot(data=score_sample)+
        facet_grid(
          index~sp_range,
          switch = "y",

            sp_range = c(

            )
          )

        geom_point(
          aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2,col=grp_nn),
          alpha=0.75,size=1
        )+
        stat_ellipse(
          aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2,fill=grp_nn,color = grp_nn),
          geom="polygon",level=0.95,alpha=0.1
        )+
        geom_point(
          data=score_sample %>% 
            summarise(
              x=mean(NMDS1),y=mean(NMDS2),
              .by=c(sp_range,index,grp_nn)
            ),
          aes(x=x,y=y,fill=grp_nn),
          col="black",
          size=2,
          shape=23
        )+
        geom_text(
          data=stress_lab,
          aes(x=Inf,y=Inf,label=stress_lab),
          hjust=1.2,vjust=1.5,size=5,family="serif"
        )+
        scale_color_discrete(labels = w09_assem$grp_nn_lab)+
        scale_fill_discrete(labels = w09_assem$grp_nn_lab)+
        scale_y_continuous(position = "right")+
        labs(
          y=NULL,
          color = "proportion of \nnon-native fish",
          fill = "proportion of \nnon-native fish",

            weight,

          )

        theme_bw()+
        theme(
          text=element_text(size=16,family="serif"),
          panel.grid=element_blank()
        )
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(weight,fig)
```

```{r}
    ),
    Terms=case_when(

      Terms=="ph" ~ "pH",
      Terms=="do" ~ "Do",
      Terms=="habitat" ~ "Habitat",
      Terms=="season" ~ "Season",
      Terms=="turbidity" ~ "Turbidity",
      Terms=="salinity" ~ "Salinity",
      Terms=="longitude:latitude" ~ "Longitude:Latitude",
      .default = Terms
    ),
    `Pr(>F)`=case_when(
      `Pr(>F)`<=0.001 ~ str_c(`Pr(>F)`, "***"),
      `Pr(>F)`<=0.01  ~ str_c(`Pr(>F)`, "**"),
      `Pr(>F)`<=0.05  ~ str_c(`Pr(>F)`, "*"),
      .default = as.character(`Pr(>F)`)
    )
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sp_range,
    values_from = c(Df,SumOfSqs,R2,`F`,`Pr(>F)`)
  ) %>% 
  nest(tabdat=!c(weight)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    tab=list(
      gt(
        tabdat,
        groupname_col = "index",
        row_group_as_column=T
      ) %>% 
        tab_spanner(
          label="All fish species",
          columns = c(
            Df_All,SumOfSqs_All,R2_All,F_All,`Pr(>F)_All`
          )
        ) %>% 
        tab_spanner(
          label="Native fish species",
          columns = c(
            Df_Native,SumOfSqs_Native,
            R2_Native,F_Native,`Pr(>F)_Native`
          )
        ) %>% 
        cols_label(
          Df_All="Df",
          SumOfSqs_All="SumOfSqs",
          R2_All="R2",
          F_All="F",
          `Pr(>F)_All`="Pr(>F)",
          Df_Native="Df",
          SumOfSqs_Native="SumOfSqs",
          R2_Native="R2",
          F_Native="F",
          `Pr(>F)_Native`="Pr(>F)"
        ) %>% 
        fmt_number(
          columns = starts_with(c("SumOfSqs", "F")),
          decimals = 2
        ) %>%
        fmt_number(
          columns = starts_with("R2"),
          decimals = 4
        ) %>% 
        sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>% 
        cols_hide(columns = starts_with("SumOfSqs"))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Supplementary Figure 8. Boxplots of distance to centroid by group."

w10_nmds$figdat_betadis <- w10_nmds$nmds %>%

        enframe(name="grp_nn",value="cld") %>%

          sp_range=sp_range,
          index=index,
          weight=weight,
          y=max(figdat_boxplot$dis)*1.1
        )

  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%

        facet_grid(
          index~sp_range,scale="free",

              bNRI = "βMPD",
              bNTI = "βMNTD",
              RCbray = "Bray-Curtis"
            )
          )
        )+
        geom_boxplot(aes(x=grp_nn,y=dis,col=grp_nn),show.legend = F)+

          data=figdat_cld,

            "B. Unweighted"
          )
        )+
        scale_x_discrete(label=w09_assem$grp_nn_lab)+
        theme_bw()+
        theme(
          text=element_text(size=16,family="serif")
        )
    )
  )
```

## w11_node
Prepare data
```{r}
w11_node <- list()

w11_node$fish_table_native <- fish_table %>% 
  select(
    any_of(filter(fish_info,!non_native)$species_ns)
  ) %>% 
  mfc() %>% 
  decostand("total")

w11_node$sample_info_rank <- sample_info %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        non_native_ratio,
        hfp,
        ph,
        do,
        longitude,
        latitude,
        salinity,
        turbidity,
        filtration_volume,
        total_reads
      ),
      ~rank(.x)
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    longitude=scale(longitude),
    latitude=scale(latitude)
  )

w11_node$tree_native <- w04_tree$tree_without_stars %>% 
  keep.tip(colnames(w11_node$fish_table_native))
```

Calculate the rank regression of the total relative abundance of native fish for each node with the covariates, and extract the residuals
```{r}
w11_node$node_resi <- with(
  w11_node,
  Ntip(tree_native) + seq_len(Nnode(tree_native))[-1]
) %>% 
  set_names(str_c("node_",.)) %>% 
  map(~extract.clade(w11_node$tree_native,.x)) %>% 
  map("tip.label") %>% 
  map(~w11_node$fish_table_native[,.x]) %>% 
  map(rowSums) %>% 
  map(rank) %>% 
  map(as_tibble_col) %>% 
  map(~bind_cols(.x,w11_node$sample_info_rank)) %>% 
  map(
    ~lm(
      data=.x,
      value~hfp+
        ph+
        do+
        salinity+
        turbidity+
        longitude*latitude+
        season+
        habitat+
        filtration_volume+
        total_reads
    )
  ) %>% 
  map(residuals) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  as.matrix()
```

Perform rank regression of the relative abundance of exotic fish with covariates, and extract the residuals
```{r}
w11_node$non_native_resi <- lm(
  data=w11_node$sample_info_rank,
  non_native_ratio~hfp+
    ph+
    do+
    salinity+
    turbidity+
    longitude*latitude+
    season+
    habitat+
    filtration_volume+
    total_reads
) %>% 
  residuals()
```

Calculate the correlation between the residual values of native fish and those of non-native fish at each node.
```{r}
w11_node$cor_result <- w11_node$node_resi %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  map(~cor.test(.x,w11_node$non_native_resi)) %>% 
  map(
    ~tibble(
      rho=.x$estimate,
      p_raw=.x$p.value
    )
  ) %>% 
  list_rbind(names_to = "node_subtree") %>% 
  mutate(
    node_subtree=as.numeric(str_extract(node_subtree,"\\d+")),
    p_adj_bh=p.adjust(p_raw,method="BH")
  )
```

Performed 9999 permutations on the residual of the non-native fish to obtain the null distribution of the absolute value of the maximum correlation.
```{r}
w11_node$rho_nulldist <- replicate(
  9999,
  {
    cor(
      w11_node$node_resi,
      sample(w11_node$non_native_resi)
    ) %>%
      max()
  }
)
```

Calculate the p-value of the permutation.
```{r}
w11_node$cor_result <- w11_node$cor_result %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    p_perm=(sum(w11_node$rho_nulldist>=abs(rho))+1)/10000,
    p_lab=case_when(
      p_perm <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_perm <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_perm <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(p_perm)
```

Visualize the result of the permutation.
```{r}
w11_node$cor_result <- w11_node$cor_result %>% 
  mutate(
    node=map(
      node_subtree,
      ~extract.clade(w11_node$tree_native,.x)
    ) %>% 
      map("tip.label") %>% 
      map_dbl(
        ~getMRCA(w04_tree$tree_without_stars,.x)
      )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    w04_tree$dat_tree,by="node"
  )

w11_node$fig_tree <- ggtree(
  w04_tree$tree,
  linewidth=0.2
) %<+% w04_tree$node_sp +
  geom_tiplab(
    align = T,
    linesize=0.1,
    family="serif",
    fontface=3,
    size=3.3,
    aes(colour=non_native)
  )+
  scale_colour_manual(
    values=c("TRUE"="#F8766D", "FALSE"="#00BFC4"), 
    guide="none"
  )+
  new_scale_color() +
  geom_cladelab(
    data=w04_tree$node_order%>% rename(order2="order"),
    mapping=aes(node=node, label=order2, col=order2),
    offset=100,
    fontsize=3.3,
    family="serif",
    show.legend=F
  )+
  geom_hilight(
    data=w04_tree$node_order %>% rename(order3="order"),
    aes(node=node,fill=order3),
    alpha = 0.1,
    show.legend = F
  )+
  new_scale_fill()+
  geom_nodepoint(
    data=w11_node$cor_result,
    mapping=aes(x=x,y=y,fill=rho),
    shape=21,col="black",size=4
  )+
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
    midpoint = 0
  )+
  geom_text2(
    data=w11_node$cor_result,
    mapping=aes(x=x,y=y,label=p_lab),
    nudge_y=0.5,size=5,family="serif",fontface = "bold"
  )+
  theme_tree2(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.1, 0.90),
    legend.justification = c("left","top")
  )+
  xlim(NA,max(node.depth.edgelength(w11_node$tree_native))*1.8)
```
